rationale: Repair the existing guarded Star Comprehensive pilot so it consumes the governed DocumentIdentityResolutionOverlay manifest shape emitted by the existing document-identity builder and recognizes the already-governed current_observed_reviewed temporal state as reviewed-current. The repair does not introduce a new currentness engine, insurance fact, recommendation authority, product scope, topic scope, or domain capability.
supersession_impact: Historical pre-guard certification artifacts remain unchanged. The existing guarded Star successor remains the active runtime; this repair only reconciles its currentness reader and limitation behavior with the established document-identity governance contract.
authority_impact: Insurance semantic and recommendation authority are unchanged. compatibility_unverified and other non-current temporal states continue to carry the currentness limitation; only the existing governance-approved current/current_observed_reviewed states avoid that stale-currentness limitation.
